meta.name: NCIS Tony and Ziva
meta.description: When his security company is attacked, Tony and Ziva must go on the run across Europe, try to figure out who is after them and maybe even learn to trust each other again so that they can finally have their unconventional happily ever after.

videos.title: No Country Is Safe
videos.overview: Their family now in danger, Tony and Ziva must find who is behind a nefarious cyber-attack.

videos.title: No Friend of Mine
videos.overview: Tony and Ziva track down the elusive hacker, only to join forces when Interpol closes in.

videos.title: Cover Story
videos.overview: Unsure who to trust and framed for a terrorist bombing, Tony and Ziva go off the grid.

videos.title: Wedding Crashers
videos.overview: Tony and Ziva use a wedding as an undercover operation to root out their enemies.

videos.title: To Be Determined
videos.overview: The Missing secretary General of Interpol leads Tony and Ziva to a high security prison.

videos.title: We've Got Company
videos.overview: The stakes grow even higher when the safe house Tali has been hiding in is compromised.

videos.title: Dark Mirror
videos.overview: Tony and Ziva return to Paris on a mission to spy on the double agents who are framing them.

videos.title: Fire Sale
videos.overview: Connecting the dots to a high-tech weapons manufacturer puts Tony and Ziva in the crosshairs.

videos.title: Ride or Die
videos.overview: With the enemy in sight and everything on the line, Tony and Ziva must face all their fears.

videos.title: Full Circle
videos.overview: To stop a deadly international attack, Tony and Ziva risk it all and learn who they can really trust.
